project.name: TODO: repo name
project.summary: TODO: describe the app, e.g. 'React + TypeScript SPA built with Vite; design tokens in src/theme/; components in src/components/ with Storybook stories'. Name the main user flows.
conventions: TypeScript strict; lint and format per repo config
use design-system tokens and existing components; no one-off colours or inline styles
every interactive element is keyboard reachable with a visible focus state and an accessible name
component tests next to the component; end-to-end tests for changed user flows
smallest diff that meets the acceptance criteria; no new dependencies without escalation

tests.host: TODO: e.g. npm test && npm run lint && npx playwright test
tests.screenshots: headless browser at desktop (1280px) and mobile (390px) widths for every changed view; look at them

reviewers.label: ui
reviewers.focus: Visual design. Matches the design system (tokens, spacing, type scale, radius), no one-off styles, layout at narrow widths, loading/empty/error states, contrast. Look at the screenshots. CHANGES for visible defects.

reviewers.label: ux
reviewers.focus: User flows and accessibility. Does the flow solve the user's problem; clear copy and errors; keyboard and screen-reader use (labels, roles, focus order, focus visibility); no dead ends. CHANGES when a user would be confused or blocked.

reviewers.label: sec
reviewers.focus: Frontend security. XSS (unsafe HTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, URL handling), CSP, secrets or tokens in the bundle or storage, third-party scripts, open redirects. CHANGES only for high or medium findings.

reviewers.label: code
reviewers.focus: Correctness and code quality. Each acceptance criterion is met and a test proves it; state handling and effects; type safety; bundle size; fits project.conventions. Run the tests yourself and add the line `Tests: <command> -> <result>`. CHANGES for any bug or unmet criterion.

escalate_on: a new third-party script, font or CDN load
a change to authentication or token storage
a change to analytics or tracking
